method: Construct exactly three frame patterns from original dimensions. Keep twelve turned base frames, then three unturned frames in the first roof row. The last row has 3-k unturned followed by k turned frames, k=1,2,3. Derive one cog phase from tooth vertices and one outward axis pitch from all convex-piece differences plus the source gap square; no angle/pitch sweep. For k=1 use a3x3 left pool and2x3 right pool above their corresponding roof tops. For k=2,3 use4x3 above the highest roof and1x4 right of the second roof row above the first row. These latter16-site pools each induce every15-of16 case. All33 intended cores receive complete original-source checks even if invalid; invalid cases cannot proceed to a solver. Original holes are preserved, not nesting space. No old coordinates, optimizer states, numeric geometry or initializer is consumed. Historical orientation comparison occurs in a separate census.
